verdict.rationale: Snyk supports some automatic event-driven actions (CI/CD pipeline scans on push/PR, automatic PR generation for fixes, hooks-based agentic security triggers for AI coding assistants, and a 'Policy management' feature) but there is no documentation of a general user-defined rule/trigger-action engine (e.g., custom conditions mapped to arbitrary automated actions). Missing for 10: detailed policy/rule authoring docs, examples of custom trigger conditions, and independent confirmation that policy management supports flexible event-action rules beyond built-in scan/PR/hook workflows.
